company.shortDescription: Ankorstore is a wholesale marketplace that connects independent shop owners and specialist brands with neighborhood retailers.
company.description: Ankorstore is an online B2B marketplace that connects independent shop owners and specialist brands with neighborhood retailers. It offers benefits for both retailers and brands. Retailers have the possibility to discover and select from thousands of brands in just a few clicks, benefit from 60-day payment terms, test sales with a low minimum order quantity, and take advantage of the constantly evolving tools offered by the platform. As for brands and creators, Ankorstore allows them to easily sell their products to stores all around Europe, benefitting from direct contact and returns with retailers, and payment upon delivery, solving any cash flow issues.
